Coordination contract tuple: R set of roles (orchestrator, specialists, aggregator, human oversight; roles distinct from agents); T scope function assigning disjoint task sets to roles; Sigma input/output schemas per role (typed records, JSON schemas, structured reports); E escalation predicates over observable pipeline state with staged escalation policies (e.g., specialized validator -> stronger model -> human authority); A audit obligations (role, inputs, tool invocations, outputs, validations, approvals). Execution trace and audit trail; runtime monitor

Coordination-contract loop (Fig. 1): orchestrator decomposes work and assigns scoped tasks -> specialist agents produce structured reports -> aggregator -> human oversight approves, overrides or reassigns; escalation paths and persistent artifact flows. Monitor step: receive event -> identify role -> check scope and schema -> update state -> evaluate predicates -> invoke escalation handler -> append audit record.
